source.notes: bias_sigma = mean horizontal error after common mode cancellation over a 1.184 km baseline (0.713 m, against 1.202 m standalone in the same run) / sqrt(pi/2) (circular Gaussian), rounded to 0.1 mm. Literature value for one low cost receiver on a moving rover with a high grade reference, not a measurement of show drones; mapping and setting are judgements, so all values stay assumed. Other values: degraded_fraction 0.25 (scenario of docs/SENSITIVITY.md) and the StressConfig defaults.
